doc: Reel style 'series' (reference trait: a weekly-series talking head in a split screen, image inserts on top and the speaker below, a kinetic one-word-per-line hook, boxed auto-captions, a series title card with a sticker burst; no pinned header: the card owns the brand and the top window is a flat panel when no inset shows).

reel.summary: split screen (images on top, speaker below), kinetic word-stack hook, boxed autocaptions, series title card with sticker burst

title.doc: the series word, big in the editorial face (on the title card)

kicker.doc: small grotesk line above the series word (type it in UPPERCASE)

tag.doc: text in the yellow sticker burst on the title card

ep.doc: episode line in the hand marker face, on the title card

hook_t.doc: when the kinetic word stack runs: {in_ms, out_ms}

card_t.doc: when the series title card shows: {in_ms, out_ms}

inset1.doc: inset 1: the index of an image in the `images` input (0 is the first), or 'none' for no inset

inset1_t.doc: when inset 1 shows: {in_ms, out_ms} on the source timeline (the reel command spreads them over the take)

inset2.doc: inset 2: the index of an image in the `images` input (0 is the first), or 'none' for no inset

inset2_t.doc: when inset 2 shows: {in_ms, out_ms} on the source timeline (the reel command spreads them over the take)

inset3.doc: inset 3: the index of an image in the `images` input (0 is the first), or 'none' for no inset

inset3_t.doc: when inset 3 shows: {in_ms, out_ms} on the source timeline (the reel command spreads them over the take)

inset4.doc: inset 4: the index of an image in the `images` input (0 is the first), or 'none' for no inset

inset4_t.doc: when inset 4 shows: {in_ms, out_ms} on the source timeline (the reel command spreads them over the take)

cta.doc: closing line in the grotesk face (empty = none)

cta_accent.doc: second closing line in the italic editorial face (empty = none)

cta_t.doc: when the closing lines show: {in_ms, out_ms} (the reel command sets the last 2.5 s)
